# Subway Seat for Palette JSON

The whole palette as data: every flavor and role in hex, RGB and HSL, with names, ANSI order and syntax roles. subway-seat.tokens.json is the same in W3C design-token form for Tokens Studio and Style Dictionary.

[Palette JSON](https://github.com/oddurs/subway-seat) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/json/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| All three | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | wherever your tool reads it |
| All three | [`subway-seat.tokens.json`](subway-seat.tokens.json) | Tokens Studio (Load from file) or a Style Dictionary source |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in any script or tool that reads JSON:

```sh
jq -r '.flavors.walnut.colors.orange.hex' subway-seat.json
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in any script or tool that reads JSON:

```sh
jq -r '.flavors.tunnel.colors.orange.hex' subway-seat.json
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in any script or tool that reads JSON:

```sh
jq -r '.flavors.enamel.colors.orange.hex' subway-seat.json
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
